post.description: Add a new reading activity for a user's book.

put.description: Update details of a specific reading activity by its ID.

delete.description: Permanently delete a specific reading activity by its ID.

get.description: Get a list of all user books, optionally filtered by user_id.

get.description: Get details of a specific user book, including its owner and reading activities.
get.summary: Get a user book by its ID

put.description: Update details of an existing user book by its ID.

delete.description: Soft delete a user book by its ID.

get.description: Retrieve a list of all reading activities associated with a given UserBook ID.
get.summary: Get all reading activities for a specific user book

post.description: Create a new user with the input payload

get.description: Get a single user by their ID

put.description: Update an existing user with the input payload

get.description: Get a recap of a user's reading activities

patch.description: Soft delete a user by their ID (sets DeletedAt and DeletedBy fields)

valid.description: Valid is true if Time is not NULL

cover.description: URL atau path ke gambar cover

end_date.description: omitempty is fine here. Consider *time.Time if clearing is needed and zero value is significant.

start_date.description: omitempty might not be ideal if you want to clear it, but for time.Time zero value is tricky.

total_pages.description: Pointer to distinguish between 0 and not provided

role.description: Role is optional, defaults to 'user' if not provided or handled in controller
